results.description: Register a new user with valid details
results.expected: User created, password stored as bcrypt hash, wallet created with balance 0
results.actual: HTTP 201; bcrypt hash stored: true; wallet balance: 0.00

results.description: Register with an email already in use
results.expected: Request rejected; no duplicate user
results.actual: HTTP 409 "Email already registered"; users with this email: 1

results.description: Log in with correct credentials
results.expected: Session created; user details returned without hash
results.actual: HTTP 200; session valid: true; hash in response: false

results.description: Log in with a wrong password
results.expected: HTTP 401 with generic message
results.actual: HTTP 401 "Invalid email or password"; same message for unknown email: true

results.description: Call a wallet endpoint without a session
results.expected: HTTP 401; no data returned
results.actual: HTTP 401 "Authentication required"

results.description: Deposit a positive amount
results.expected: Balance increases; transaction recorded
results.actual: HTTP 200; balance 0.00 to 5000.00; transaction #28 recorded

results.description: Deposit zero, a negative or a non-numeric amount
results.expected: Request rejected; balance unchanged
results.actual: HTTP 400, 400, 400; balance unchanged: true

results.description: Withdraw more than the balance
results.expected: HTTP 400; balance unchanged
results.actual: HTTP 400 "Insufficient funds"; balance unchanged: true

results.description: Transfer between two users
results.expected: Both balances update atomically; one transaction row
results.actual: HTTP 200; sender 5000.00 to 4800.00; recipient 0.00 to 200.00; one row #29

results.description: Transfer to a non-existent email
results.expected: HTTP 404; no balance changes
results.actual: HTTP 404 "Recipient not found"; balance unchanged: true

results.description: View transaction history
results.expected: All transactions listed newest first, paginated
results.actual: HTTP 200; 2 transactions; newest first: true; 1 per page gives 2 pages

results.description: Small transfer consistent with normal behaviour
results.expected: Scored; no alert created
results.actual: HTTP 200; scored; fraud score 0.211667; alerts: 0

results.description: Transfer that drains the sender balance
results.expected: Scored at or above the threshold; pending alert created
results.actual: HTTP 200; fraud score 0.751667; alert #8 pending; transfer completed: true

results.description: Administrator confirms and dismisses alerts
results.expected: Status set to confirmed_fraud or cleared with reviewer and time
results.actual: Confirm HTTP 200, dismiss HTTP 200; #8 confirmed_fraud, #9 cleared; reviewer and time recorded: true; second review refused: HTTP 409

results.description: Non-administrator calls an admin endpoint
results.expected: HTTP 403
results.actual: List HTTP 403; review HTTP 403 "Administrator access required"

results.description: Transfer while the inference service is stopped
results.expected: Transfer completes; marked unscored
results.actual: Run separately: stop the scoring service, then node tests/run-tests.js --tc16

results.description: Create a locked savings goal and move money into it
results.expected: Goal created; wallet debited; goal balance credited; recorded as savings_deposit
results.actual: Create HTTP 201; deposit HTTP 200; wallet 2000.00 to 1500.00; goal holds 500; recorded as savings_deposit

results.description: Withdraw from a goal before its unlock date
results.expected: HTTP 409; wallet and goal unchanged
results.actual: HTTP 409 "This goal is locked until 10 Dec 2026"; wallet unchanged: true; goal still holds 500

results.description: Withdraw everything from a goal with no lock
results.expected: Money returned to wallet; goal closed; recorded as savings_release
results.actual: HTTP 200; wallet 1200.00 to 1500.00; goal closed; recorded as savings_release

results.description: Loan limit follows recent inflow
results.expected: Limit is 30% of money received in the last 30 days, rounded down to 50
results.actual: HTTP 200; received 2,000.00; limit 600; eligible: true

results.description: Take a loan within the limit, then apply again
results.expected: Wallet credited; amount due includes 7.5% fee; second application refused
results.actual: HTTP 201; wallet 1500.00 to 1900.00; due 430 by 2026-12-10; second application HTTP 409

results.description: Repay a loan in two parts
results.expected: Overpayment refused; partial then final repayment clears the loan
results.actual: Overpay HTTP 400; part HTTP 200 (230 left); final HTTP 200; loan repaid

results.description: Borrow after a transaction was confirmed as fraud
results.expected: Loan refused with a fraud-related reason
results.actual: Eligible: false; "Loans are unavailable because a recent transaction on this account was confirmed as fraud."; application HTTP 409

results.description: Bank transfer, and one with an invalid account number
results.expected: Valid transfer debits the wallet and is fraud-scored as a cash-out; invalid one rejected
results.actual: Invalid HTTP 400; valid HTTP 200; wallet 1470.00 to 1220.00; scored, fraud score 0.485000

results.description: Pay bill, buy goods and airtime
results.expected: Each payment debits the wallet without a fraud score; invalid numbers rejected
results.actual: Invalid HTTP 400; payments HTTP 200, 200, 200; wallet 1220.00 to 1050.00; no fraud check shown: true

results.description: Request money, pay it, and decline another
results.expected: Request paid through a scored transfer; mismatched or reused transfer refused; decline recorded
results.actual: Create HTTP 201; wrong amount HTTP 400; paid HTTP 200 (transfer scored); reused transfer HTTP 400; decline HTTP 200; statuses paid, declined
